description: Na₂CaC₂H₁₀O₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.38 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.60 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.62 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.63 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Ca and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one C, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two H atoms.
